name: Antagonist’s Ring
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of chameleon power and functions as such with one exception. When the wearer attempts to use the disguise self ability, his appearance is different to each observer. In all cases, the form the wearer takes is of an individual whom the observer dislikes.

As a result, all NPCs begin as unfriendly for Diplomacy checks. Additionally, if the wearer is involved in combat, all opponents will attempt to attack him if possible, though they will not put themselves at unnecessary risk to do so.

The antagonist’s ring can only be removed by a remove curse, which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of chameleon power

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
